name: Daddy Issues
source: The story starts with the upbeat British protagonist, Jake, as he relocates to America and moves in with his dad’s old friend, Nate, and Nate’s introvert son, Caleb. In Jake’s mind, this is the perfect time to reinvent himself and seek out wild and exciting thrills. However, as with most  things in life, things never usually go quite as planned.
